subject.title: refactor(qa): retire the standalone Matrix QA runtime

question: After the topology fix, should maintainers approve this exact-head qa-matrix package removal plus reusable Matrix QA Live workflow secret boundary?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes dependency ownership, package graph state, and a secret-bearing reusable release QA workflow, which repository policy treats as human security and ownership approval rather than a purely mechanical code review result.

options.title: Fix topology and approve exact head
options.body: Pass liveScenarioIds into the Matrix adapter, prove a topology-heavy profile, then have an authorized dependency/workflow owner approve the exact package graph and secret-boundary changes before merge.

options.title: Split workflow routing
options.body: Land the Matrix QA runtime consolidation separately and move reusable release workflow routing plus secret handling into a smaller security-reviewed PR.

options.title: Pause the retirement
options.body: Keep the standalone qa-matrix runtime until maintainers are ready to own the package deletion and release QA workflow churn.

recommendation.title: Fix topology and approve exact head
recommendation.body: Pass liveScenarioIds into the Matrix adapter, prove a topology-heavy profile, then have an authorized dependency/workflow owner approve the exact package graph and secret-boundary changes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent package-boundary and workflow history makes this the best available routing owner for the dependency graph and reusable workflow approval question.
